acceptance.behavior: Opening the protected /dashboard route after the browser-session cookie is discarded returns the user to /login.
The responsive login form explains that only an explicit Remember me choice keeps the session after the browser closes.
Closing the browser removes session authority without deleting the durable Supabase Auth identity or profile record.
The shared session guard treats Supabase session state as the authority before allowing a protected route to remain open.
The exact-revision browser journey writes the required PBOS result, screenshots, trace, and accessibility artifacts after its checks pass.
One Playwright journey signs in without Remember me, reconstructs a browser with only persistent state, and verifies desktop and mobile behavior.
The browser journey checks mobile overflow and rejects serious or critical axe violations on the reauthentication screen.
Default Supabase authentication cookies omit persistent expiry, while deletion cookies retain their required Max-Age behavior.
